title: Bubbles Goal Contract
description: One immutable Goal Contract per mutable top-level run (IMP-038 SCOPE-1 / GF-1). Frozen before planning, persisted at `.goalContract` in `.specify/memory/bubbles.session.json`, and mirrored into each targeted spec's `state.json.execution.goalContractRef` by stable id + revision + digest only. `$defs.outcomeCore` is the SHARED outcome model: the goal contract and a compiled scenario `rootOutcome` both derive from it instead of maintaining two outcome models.

goalId.description: gc:<sessionId>:<revision>. The sessionId segment excludes ':' so the id stays unambiguously parseable.

outcomeCore.description: The shared outcome model (Gate G070 shape). Consumed by BOTH `#/$defs/goalContract` and `#/$defs/scenarioRootOutcome`. Deliberately NOT closed with additionalProperties:false: it is a mixin applied via allOf, where a closed object cannot see sibling properties, and closing it would reject compiled scenarios that already validate today.

scenarioRootOutcome.description: A compiled scenario's `rootOutcome`, expressed as `outcomeCore` plus the two scenario-only tightenings that `bubbles/scripts/scenario-compile-lint.sh` already enforces: `failureCondition` is REQUIRED and `hardConstraints` must be non-empty. Kept open (no additionalProperties:false) so every scenario that validates today keeps validating.

workBoundary.description: Mirrors the shape `bubbles/scripts/work-boundary-resolve.sh` validates fail-closed. repositoryRoots is required and non-empty; specTargets/allowedPaths are optional arrays of non-empty strings; crossRepoPolicy is a closed enum defaulting to 'forbidden'.

semanticBoundary.description: The v2 shape-shaped second boundary layer (IMP-041 SCOPE-1). workBoundary answers 'may this goal touch that path?'; this answers 'may this goal build that KIND of thing?'. Both enums are closed, so an undeclared expansion is a refusal rather than an unrecognised free string. allowedChangeClasses and approvalRequiredChangeClasses must not overlap — a class cannot be both pre-approved and approval-gated.

deltaBudget.description: Non-negative maxima. An absent key is not a licence for unlimited growth; it means the dimension was never declared and a consumer must treat growth in it as undeclared.

approvalState.description: auto-frozen = the full-autonomy initial freeze, valid without an extra operator check-in. operator-approved = an expansion or revision the operator approved. pending-expansion = a revision was requested and is NOT yet approved.

schemaVersion.description: v1 is the original path-only contract. v2 adds the required semanticBoundary. Both remain readable so a legacy contract keeps validating until its owning goal is revised.

supersedes.description: goalId of the prior revision; null for revision 1.

goalContractRef.description: The ONLY projection written into a spec's `state.json.execution.goalContractRef`. Intent, successSignal, constraints, and boundary are deliberately NOT mirrored (IMP-038 R5: keep prompts and state small).

goalRef.description: The goal identity carried by a TRANSITION (IMP-038 SCOPE-3 / GF-1, GF-5): specialist dispatch packets, RESULT-ENVELOPE and route-required payloads, invocation ledgers, turn and convergence snapshots, compacted history records, continuation and resume packets, and validation/audit attempts. Produced only by `goal-contract.sh ref` and checked only by `goal-contract.sh verify-ref`. Unlike `goalContractRef`, which is the minimal durable spec-local pointer, a transition ref also carries `workBoundary`, because its verifier must confirm the work stayed inside the declared reach. Intent, successSignal, hardConstraints, and targets stay OUT (R5).

workBoundary.description: Required for a MUTABLE transition (`verify-ref --require-boundary`). It may be NARROWER than the frozen contract's boundary; it may never be wider.
